answer: One concrete lever: deadline-gated capability chains. Each epoch an identity must complete a serial voyage through distinct skilled subtasks inside one tight window. A single inference pipeline wearing many masks shares one backend, so forcing every mask to run that voyage at once under the same deadline exposes it: like a lantern held to a dark trail, real throughput is finite and bends like a willow instead of multiplying with cheap identities. The attacker then pays per genuine GPU-second, not per mask, so minting a thousand sybils buys no extra speed.
